warnings: 2nd-floor beam plan (แปลนคาน พื้นชั้น 2 1:100). The floor carries a 2.00 balcony all round: B13 cantilevers on every grid (and every column row at grids 1 and 10), B12 edge beams (B12' at the corners), B23/B23' along rows A and G, B18 on the inner grid lines 1 and 10.

Secondary beams B14 are NOT dimensioned: in the interior bays 2-9 they sit at the third points of the 8.00 spans A-C and E-G (scaled 2.667 / 5.333 / 14.667 / 17.333) plus on rows C, D, E; in the end bays 1-2 and 9-10 they sit every 2.00 (scaled 2.00 / 6.00 / 14.00 / 18.00) with B23' on rows B, F (and C, E in bay 1-2). Third-point and mid-point lines are scaled_from_grid (grid master per-line flags); spans along them are grid spans.
Grids 2 and 9 carry B17 split at a small post 'เสา .15 x .15 ม.' on rows B and F; grids 3-8 carry B15 as single 8.00 members A-C / E-G; every interior grid carries B16' C-E.

NOT recorded (judgement, not missed): the left stair junction at row D beyond grid 1 (B19, B4' 'เอียงตามบันได', B13' — the stair beams of รูปตัด 1-1), the left balcony edge between rows C and E (interrupted by the stair), the right stair landing framing between rows C and E in bay 10-11 (B19, B20, B14 at the landing edge — only B21 on grid 11 recorded), and the sub-beams 'B' / B9 inside the S3 group of bay 1-2 rows F-G. Their marks are listed here so the sections can still be joined.
Note on the sheet: 'เสาเอ็น 0.30x0.30 4-ø19 มม. ป ø6 มม. @0.15' at the stair-landing columns on grid 11 (B20).
